applicability: any working-tree read standing in for a named revision, including single-branch repositories where a dirty tree diverges from a matching HEAD; excludes reads already bound to the revision itself, such as git show <rev>:<path> or an immutable export
destination: AGENTS.md One writer per checkout (confirm the base before reading it)

evidence.source_reference: PR #119 be1bd0b builder session reading a parked shared checkout

expected_behavior: Read the named revision rather than a tree standing in for it: git show <rev>:<path> is the revision's bytes unconditionally. A working tree can diverge from a matching HEAD in ways a status check does not report -- untracked-but-ignored paths, and tracked paths carrying assume-unchanged or skip-worktree, both reproduced -- so these are an open list, not a checklist to clear. Where a tree read is unavoidable, confirm git rev-parse HEAD is the base, confirm cleanliness for the paths read, inspect git ls-files -v for index flags, and record that the read was tree-based so a later reader knows which guarantee it carries.
observation: A builder read repository bytes off a shared checkout parked on an unrelated branch and treated them as its assigned base. An import present only on the parked branch was assumed present on the base; the resulting NameError was caught by the builder's own mutation proof rather than by any gate.
reason: Landed 2026-08-20: One writer per checkout now requires reading a named revision as that revision, not a working tree standing in for it.
